paragraphs.text: Appointments with a doctor can be booked online, by phone or at reception. Phone lines open at 8 am, and most same-day appointments are taken within the first hour, so we recommend using the online system if possible.
Routine appointments last ten minutes and can be booked up to four weeks in advance. If you have more than one problem to discuss, please book a double appointment.
For repeat prescriptions, please allow two working days. Prescriptions can be ordered online or by leaving the request form in the box by the main door; we do not take prescription requests by phone.
Our nurses can see you for blood tests, vaccinations and dressings. Blood tests are only available before 11 am, as samples must reach the hospital laboratory the same day.

If you need medical help urgently when the centre is closed, call the out-of-hours number shown on our website. Please do not come to the centre without an appointment unless a member of staff has asked you to.
